review.reason: Measured v0.24.1 on-demand two-owner chat history reconciliation adds a lazily loaded manual Sync path and a bounded, authenticated server repair action. The previous v0.24.0 READY Preview had only 38 B raw and 48 B gzip app-total headroom. The first v0.24.1 Vercel build exceeded aggregate totals by 1,921 B raw, 805 B gzip and 1,872 B unique precache, while all four entry/initial/Home closure ceilings passed. This reviewed change permits the measured new feature while preserving the historic baseline, existing four startup-critical ceilings, and exact canonical+Vercel acceptance. No unbounded bundle or runtime loop budget exception.
